verdict.rationale: Mastercard Open Finance (Finicity) is a financial-data and payments API platform, not an agent or AI host, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this product type. The evidence describes only an official Mastercard MCP server (the server role), which other AI tools such as Claude or Cursor connect to. That is a different capability and does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
